dedupe_keys.name: gross domestic product gdp data of vietnam from 2005 to 2017 at 2010 price

description: A Viet Nam energy-system data deposit provides national gross domestic product figures for 2005 to 2017 in 2010 prices. Zenodo lists a public 15 KB ZIP of Excel material under CC BY 4.0. The provider says it copied the spreadsheets from the General Statistics Office of Viet Nam in March 2019. Historical GDP can be used as one economic driver when calibrating energy-demand or infrastructure-investment scenarios. This is a national aggregate series, not provincial output, household income or a forecast after 2017. The landing page does not state currency units, deflator details, workbook columns or later revisions by the statistics office. Upstream GSO publication terms and the Zenodo licence claim should be kept separate. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this archived GDP set. The ZIP was not downloaded, so its tables, values and consistency with the cited GSO source remain unverified.
name: Gross Domestic Product (GDP) data of Vietnam from 2005 to 2017 at 2010 price
